summary.zh: 中央红军主力从瑞金等地出发，开始战略转移。
summary.en: The main force of the Central Red Army sets out from Ruijin and begins its strategic transfer.

description.zh: 1934 年 10 月，中央红军主力及中央机关从江西瑞金、于都等地出发，踏上长征路。
description.en: In October 1934, the main force and central organs of the Central Red Army left Ruijin, Yudu, and other places in Jiangxi and set out on the Long March.

description.zh: 中央红军各部队先后在于都地区集结，10 月 17 日渡过于都河，向湘南挺进。
description.en: Units of the Central Red Army gathered in the Yudu area and crossed the Yudu River on October 17, advancing toward southern Hunan.

summary.en: The Red Army breaks through the Kuomintang blockade around Yizhang.

description.zh: 中央红军连续突破国民党军设置的多道封锁线，11 月中旬进至宜章、郴州一带。
description.en: The Central Red Army broke through several Kuomintang blockade lines in succession and reached the Yizhang and Chenzhou area in mid-November.

summary.zh: 长征初期最惨烈的战役，红军付出巨大代价渡过湘江。
summary.en: The bloodiest battle of the early Long March; the Red Army crosses the Xiang River at great cost.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月底至 12 月初，中央红军在广西全州、兴安间抢渡湘江，突破第四道封锁线，部队由出发时的八万余人锐减至三万余人。
description.en: From late November to early December 1934, the Central Red Army crossed the Xiang River between Quanzhou and Xing’an in Guangxi, breaking the fourth blockade line. Its strength fell from more than 80,000 to about 30,000.

summary.en: The CPC Central Committee holds an emergency meeting at Tongdao to discuss the army’s direction.

description.zh: 湘江战役后，中央红军在湖南通道召开会议，采纳毛泽东的建议，改向敌人力量薄弱的贵州前进。
description.en: After the Battle of the Xiang River, the Central Red Army met at Tongdao, Hunan, and adopted Mao Zedong’s proposal to move toward Guizhou, where enemy forces were weaker.

summary.en: The Liping meeting decides to advance into central Guizhou, laying the groundwork for the Zunyi meeting.

description.zh: 1934 年 12 月 18 日，中共中央政治局在贵州黎平召开会议，决定放弃北上湘西的原定计划，改向贵州腹地进军。
description.en: On December 18, 1934, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met at Liping, Guizhou, and abandoned the original plan to move north to western Hunan in favor of advancing into central Guizhou.

summary.en: The Houchang meeting reaffirms the Liping decision and limits the military authority of Bo Gu and Li De.

description.zh: 1934 年 12 月 31 日至 1935 年 1 月 1 日，中共中央政治局在贵州瓮安猴场召开会议，重申黎平会议决定，并规定重大军事行动须经政治局讨论。
description.en: From December 31, 1934, to January 1, 1935, the Political Bureau met at Houchang, Weng’an, Guizhou. It reaffirmed the Liping decision and required major military actions to be discussed by the Political Bureau.

summary.zh: 确立毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位，是长征的转折点。
summary.en: Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 15 日至 17 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议在遵义召开，总结第五次反“围剿”失败和长征初期失利的教训，实际确立了毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位。
description.en: From January 15 to 17, 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau was held at Zunyi. It reviewed the failures of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign and the early Long March, and effectively established Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army.

summary.zh: 红军在土城与川军激战，随后一渡赤水。
summary.en: The Red Army fights a fierce battle with Sichuan troops at Tucheng, then crosses the Chishui River for the first time.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 28 日，中央红军在贵州习水土城地区与川军郭勋祺部激战，因敌情判断有误未能取胜，随即西渡赤水河。
description.en: On January 28, 1935, the Central Red Army fought Guo Xunqi’s Sichuan troops at Tucheng, Xishui, Guizhou. After failing to win because of a misjudgment of enemy strength, it crossed the Chishui River to the west.

name.en: Second crossing of the Chishui River

summary.zh: 红军由太平渡、二郎滩东渡赤水河，回师黔北。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu and Erlangtan and returns to northern Guizhou.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月中旬，中央红军在四川古蔺太平渡、二郎滩等地东渡赤水河，回师贵州，攻占娄山关、再占遵义。
description.en: In mid-February 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu and Erlangtan in Gulin, Sichuan, returned to Guizhou, captured Loushan Pass, and retook Zunyi.

summary.zh: 红军攻克娄山关，取得长征以来首次大捷。
summary.en: The Red Army captures Loushan Pass, its first major victory of the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 25 日，红一军团等部攻克娄山关，随后再占遵义，取得长征以来最大的一次胜利。
description.en: On February 25, 1935, the First Army Corps and other units captured Loushan Pass and then retook Zunyi, achieving the largest victory since the start of the Long March.

summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Maotai and nearby, feinting to draw off enemy forces.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 16 日至 17 日，中央红军在贵州仁怀茅台镇附近西渡赤水河，作出北渡长江姿态，诱使国民党军西调。
description.en: From March 16 to 17, 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River westward near Maotai, Renhuai, Guizhou, posing as if to cross the Yangtze and luring Kuomintang forces westward.

summary.en: The Red Army secretly crosses the Chishui River eastward and escapes encirclement.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 21 日至 22 日，中央红军从二郎滩、太平渡等地秘密东渡赤水河，随后南渡乌江，佯攻贵阳，调出滇军。
description.en: From March 21 to 22, 1935, the Central Red Army secretly crossed the Chishui River eastward at Erlangtan, Taipingdu, and other places, then crossed the Wu River southward, feinted toward Guiyang, and drew Yunnan troops out.

summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Jinsha River at Jiaopingdu and escapes hundreds of thousands of pursuing troops.

description.en: In early May 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River at Jiaopingdu and other ferries in Luquan, Yunnan, breaking out of the Kuomintang encirclement.

summary.en: The Huili meeting unifies strategic thinking and decides to continue north.

description.en: On May 12, 1935, the Political Bureau held an enlarged meeting at Huili, Sichuan. It criticized views that sought to change the northward strategy and decided to continue north to join the Fourth Front Army.

summary.en: Twenty-two heroes seize Luding Bridge, foiling the enemy’s attempt to annihilate the Red Army.

summary.zh: 毛儿盖会议确定北上方针，决定分左右两路军行动。
summary.en: The Maoergai meeting confirms the northward strategy and decides to advance in two columns.

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 20 日，中共中央政治局在四川松潘毛儿盖召开会议，确定北上建立川陕甘根据地的方针。
description.en: On August 20, 1935, the Political Bureau met at Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan, and confirmed the strategy of moving north to establish the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu base area.

summary.zh: 红军穿越茫茫草地，付出巨大牺牲。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the vast grasslands at great cost.

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月下旬，红军从毛儿盖出发穿越松潘草地，恶劣的自然环境造成大量非战斗减员。
description.en: In late August 1935, the Red Army set out from Maoergai and crossed the Songpan grasslands. The harsh environment caused heavy non-combat losses.

summary.zh: 红军攻克天险腊子口，打开进入甘南的通道。
summary.en: The Red Army captures the natural barrier of Lazikou, opening the route into southern Gansu.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 17 日，红一军团攻克甘肃迭部腊子口，为中央红军北上打开最后一道天险。
description.en: On September 17, 1935, the First Army Corps captured Lazikou in Diebu, Gansu, opening the last natural barrier for the Central Red Army’s advance north.

summary.zh: 红军在哈达铺整编，并得知陕北有红军和根据地。
summary.en: The Red Army reorganizes at Hadapu and learns of the Red Army and base area in northern Shaanxi.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 18 日，中央红军进驻甘肃宕昌哈达铺，进行整编，并从报纸上得知陕北有红军和根据地。
description.en: On September 18, 1935, the Central Red Army arrived at Hadapu, Dangchang, Gansu, reorganized, and learned from newspapers that a Red Army and base area existed in northern Shaanxi.

summary.zh: 中央红军到达陕北吴起镇，结束长征。
summary.en: The Central Red Army reaches Wuqi in northern Shaanxi, ending the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中央红军到达陕西吴起镇，与陕北红军会合，中央红军长征胜利结束。
description.en: On October 19, 1935, the Central Red Army reached Wuqi, Shaanxi, joined the Shaanxi Red Army, and brought its Long March to a victorious end.

summary.zh: 直罗镇战役为党中央把革命大本营放在西北举行奠基礼。
summary.en: The Battle of Zhiluozhen lays the foundation for establishing the Party Central Committee’s base in the northwest.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月 21 日至 24 日，红一方面军在陕西富县直罗镇歼灭国民党军一个师又一个团，为党中央把革命大本营放在西北奠定了基础。
description.en: From November 21 to 24, 1935, the First Front Army destroyed a Kuomintang division and a regiment at Zhiluozhen, Fu County, Shaanxi, laying the foundation for the Party Central Committee to establish its base in the northwest.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 9 日，红一方面军与红四方面军在甘肃会宁会师，长征取得决定性胜利。
description.en: On October 9, 1936, the First Front Army and the Fourth Front Army met at Huining, Gansu, a decisive victory of the Long March.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 22 日，红一方面军与红二方面军在宁夏西吉将台堡会师，标志着红军长征胜利结束。
description.en: On October 22, 1936, the First Front Army and the Second Front Army met at Jiangtaibao, Xiji, Ningxia, marking the victorious end of the Red Army’s Long March.
